items.title: Honeymoon trip to Soviet Union (1988)
items.summary: As mayor of Burlington, VT, Sanders led a sister-city delegation to Yaroslavl, USSR in 1988. At the time he praised some aspects of Soviet social programs. These statements are documented and publicly available.

sources.name: Politico
sources.description: Reporting on archived footage of Sanders's 1988 Yaroslavl sister-city trip

sources.name: CCTV Center for Media & Democracy
sources.description: Burlington government access recording of Sanders press conference upon return from Yaroslavl
